children: Eightco's revenue fell 98.3% year over year as Forever 8 suspended new order fulfillment for its largest customer and stopped buying inventory under its legacy model. Earnings swung to income from a loss, primarily reflecting a $59.3 million digital-asset fair-value gain versus a loss in the prior-year period.
¹ Reported as “Revenues, net”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to Eightco Holdings, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share – diluted”.
: Revenue fell 98.3% as the company halted new order fulfillment for its largest customer and ceased legacy-model inventory purchases.
: Forever 8 is onboarding customers under a new model that purchases goods against customer orders and invoices upon shipment.
: Remaining inventory was liquidated during the quarter at amounts below carrying value, contributing to the gross loss.
: The company recorded a $59.3 million fair-value gain, reflecting higher market prices at September 30 than at June 30.
: Near-cash liquidity was approximately $126.7 million at September 30; management said resources support operations for at least the next 12 months.
